entries.contribution:
another fun idea is probably to set the bag of cacao on holiday mode and then as and when it gets scanned, it reports back to our DAO where it currently is as well as the IP address of the person who scanned it

That way, it gives us some really good visibility on which artwork that @⁨Iwona Fluda⁩ provided which we have on the face of our bag of cacao is driving the most curiosity 🤔

During a conversation I had with Fatima she mentioned the purpose of art is to provoke the perceiver to _Think Different_ perhaps even to the extend of having a _Change of Heart_

A bag of cacao that really went far and wide perhaps is a great proxy to how provocative the piece of art on showcase is
Great to see you in person, Gary! See you in a year 🎊🤣
For anyone interested, list of events in Davos during WEF: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YTj85Co_xYZVuVicdkMxwU31aJHcBcq-DGyl4B6dt18/edit?gid=793045675#gid=793045675

Hi! One of our incredible partners in Davos still has event spaces available during the World Economic Forum—a fantastic opportunity to host something impactful right at the heart of the action. If you’re interested, let me know, and I’d be happy to share more details.
Sounds delicious 😋 - could you please share more via pm?

narrative.text: Iwona Fluda contributed 35 times to TrueSight DAO projects including 20250617_beerhall, Agroverse, Sun Mint, and telegram_chatlog from February 2023 to November 2025. Her work primarily consisted of human effort hours rewarded at 100 TDG per hour, alongside attendance at seven Facetime meetings for Build Game strategy sessions. She also suggested one strategy idea, wrote and posted a short social media text on an account with at least 10,000 followers, contributed to legal document reviews by paragraph and bullet point, authored one official DAO social media post, and handled a single operations task for Build Game.
